verification_contract.test_function_id_requirement: Each fixture case ID maps to a test marker/name containing ma08_u06 and the exact immutable fixture revision; mapping is part of required implementation evidence
verification_contract.targeted_command_status: SPECIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED; actual command, cwd, toolchain version and log producer required in Result
verification_contract.regression_requirement: Existing WORK resolves repository approved full regression set, exact versions and cross-chapter consumers in compiled Work Order; unsupported frontend/.NET target is HOLD not fake PASS
verification_contract.negative_and_failure_requirement: All immutable fixture positive/negative/concurrency-or-failure assertions observed; record fail/skipped/untested separately
verification_contract.runtime_gate_boundary: Synthetic/fake/domain tests do not satisfy real PostgreSQL two-connection/crash, Git/SQL crash, Windows path/ACL, Restore, vendor Broker/PAPER, Controller or release journey qualification
verification_contract.review_requirement: Author evidence → existing independent Reviewer → WORK Intake; exact subject/result applicable scope and source compatibility; no self-accept
verification_contract.executor_continuity: Same unit/plan/chapter/source/oracles/evidence across CODEX/GPT+VSCode/LM; a new executor requires fresh lawful invocation and single-writer check, not new feature or progress credit

review.mandatory_original_requirement: Author evidence → existing independent Reviewer → WORK Intake; exact subject/result applicable scope and source compatibility; no self-accept
review.record_deferral: Allowed as a derived observation, never PASS
review.Lane_B: Separate explicit candidate Grant + supported route/policy + writer; unreviewed high-risk semantics cannot become formal downstream dependency
review.independence: Actual author and reviewer context/identity distinct; qualified substitute allowed, not automatically Ultra-required

planning_minimum_and_escalation.delta_override: Planning tier is a minimum for the described implementation scope, not a fixed tool/chapter rating. Any authoritative Source/Registry/Acceptance Subject/permission/capital/order/fill/persistence change is at least L3; actual Runtime/Broker/Migration/Restore/Release is L4. A separately bounded pure read-only inspection can be L2 without lowering the implementation gate.

capability.route: CODEX Sol 6.1 High primary; quota-insufficient fallback GPT+VSCode or qualified local LM, same unit/source/oracle/evidence; unsafe or unavailable fallback WAIT
capability.fallback_policy: WORK evaluates exact stable scope, objective cohort, legal tool/writer profile and full testability; no model-name-only qualification or unlimited splitting

source_environment_authority: Original full source/reverse/required companion closure and body readback
Exact dependency Result+Acceptance or qualified reuse
Mandatory review/regression/stage gate and immutable Result ref/body digest

WORK_forecast.missing_reason: No exact unit implementation/cohort/cost telemetry; existing WORK estimates before authorized execution; actual costs belong only to UnitExecutionResult

cost.unobservable: UNKNOWN with missing reason, never Provider percent as exact tokens
cost.budget_condition: Explicit original-policy finite authorization/UNKNOWN acceptance required for this Unit; not transferable from prior Grant

execution_evidence.rule: Future actual evidence only; spec, Mock PoC and fixture output cannot fill these fields

recovery_checkpoint.requirements: Preserve exact same WO/execution/reservation/dispatch/source/delta/budget/tests/telemetry/writer lineage; resume only real already-invoked identity after fresh validation; UNKNOWN outcome STOP_NO_BACKFILL
